description.title: The Ford Watch
description.premise: The watch of Harrowford has lost the old mill to raiders, and it pays a fair sum to anyone who clears it.
description.backdrop: The Marchlands lie at the edge of an old kingdom. Small walled towns keep their own watch, and bandits and raiders hold the ruins between them.
description.scope: One short job: find the way into the mill cellar and clear it of raiders.

ford.name: The Harrowford Ford
ford.brief: The river crossing below the town wall
ford.description: The river runs shallow over flat stones below the walls of Harrowford. A track climbs to the market and another leads to an old mill.

market.name: Harrowford Market
market.brief: A busy yard inside the wall
market.description: Stalls crowd a cobbled yard inside the wall. A peddler sells charms and potions from a cart.

mill.name: The Old Mill
mill.brief: A silent mill upstream of the ford
mill.description: The wheel of the mill has not turned in years. Wind moves the loose boards of the floor. A heavy door leads down to the cellar.

cellar.name: The Mill Cellar
cellar.brief: A cold cellar under the mill
cellar.description: A low cellar of wet stone. Crates and a rough camp fill the space under the grinding floor.

peddler.name: Tobin the Peddler
peddler.brief: A cheerful peddler who sells charms and potions from a cart.

watchman.name: Watchman Dunstan
watchman.brief: A tired watchman at the ford who wants the mill cleared.

raiders.name: Mill raiders
raiders.brief: A group of raiders who camp in the mill cellar.

snare.name: Hidden snare
snare.brief: A snare under the loose boards

old-dagger.name: Old dagger
old-dagger.brief: A plain dagger stuck in a beam

opening.arc: The raiders took the mill cellar a week ago and set a snare at the mill door to catch the watch. The mill key was lost; the lock must be picked or forced.

scout-mill.brief: Search the old mill and find its hidden snare

open-cellar.brief: Open the locked way into the mill cellar

talk-raiders-out.brief: Make the raiders leave the cellar without a fight

clear-mill.brief: Clear the raiders from the mill cellar
